verse: akathyaṃ paramārthena sārabhūtamidaṃ jagat | kathaṃ vadasva tattvajña vīro'aapi bhayavihvalaḥ
evaṃmahārthaṃparamaṃ kramasaṃsthaṃ su gopayet | akramastho mahāvīro gaḥ kaścid bhuvitiṣṭhate
caturviṃśatiryāḥ (?) devi kena mantreṇa khecarāḥ | prakaṭaṃ paramārthena tad vadasva yathārthataḥ
yaistu siddhairmahāvīraiḥ kramaughamavatāritam | te pūjyāḥ sarvadā rudra puṣpadhūpopahārakaiḥ
vādye tu pratipadyartha pūjāsarvārthadāyakī | kathayāmi tava snehād bhāvamāsena tāṃ śṛṇu
mūrtayaśca mahāraudrāḥ śūnyarūpāḥ svabhāvataḥ | jñātāstetvatprasādādye ṣaṭcakrapadadeśikāḥ
pujaya? asthikhaṇḍantu pāṇinā sarvathā budhaḥ | dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā ālikheccakramuttamam
kiṃ vā tubhyaṃ vahantyatāḥ (?) pṛccha tvaṃ tu paraḥ śivaḥ| kiṃ vā svabhāvabhāvena pṛcchase tu mahāmate
vaktrena parameṇaiva sarvasaṃhārakena ca ||2/13 ||
kuṃdayāgavibhāgeṣu (?) yoginīnāṃ tu sarvataḥ | tacchṛṇuṣva samāsena bhavabandhanisūdana
jñātavyāḥ sarvathā nātha aśarīrāccharīragāḥ | etāstu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ khecakrapadadarśikāḥ
caturdaśena cākrāntaṃ sṛṣṭisthaṃ dvādaśayutam | etat piṇḍākṣaraṃ yojyaṃ vyomānte padakaṃ tataḥ
mūrtayastu mahākāla kāyena manasā girā | paścāt siddhakramaṃ pūjyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
vidyārūpeṇa viddhivat sthitirūpā sadoditā | āgatasya tvamāgatya yāhaṭhāt saṃkṣayeratā
śrībhairavyuvāca athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kramārthaṃ paramaṃ dhruvam | yena vijñātamātreṇa kālijñānāruho bhavet
kecid vallanti nādanti kecid bhāvarasākulaiḥ | keci nṛtyanti gāyanti vādyanti cakre pūṭitaḥ
arūpā sarvarūpā ca mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | yā vāktraye atītā yā parārūpe khageśvarī
phalameva prayacchanti kālikājñānamuttamam | etat kramaṃ tu siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ mahātapa
ahkalasyāṃ darasthantu kuryād cakreśvara śubham | evaṃ cakrasya vinyāsaṃ kārayedakramakramam
kālasya jananī sā vai suśāntā caṇḍacakragā | asyāḥ svarūpagā kālī madhyame ca yathāśritā
sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ vai sṛṣṭisthena yutaṃ kuru | tṛtīyena yathā nyāyaṃ saptamaṃ taṃ viduḥ sadā
pūjayāmi sadā bhadre samayārthaśivapradām | kathayasya prasādena vistareṇa yathā vahiḥ
tatastu paramaṃ tattvaṃ prāptaṃ tu paramaṃ śivam  ||1/ 67 ||
brāhmaṇī pukkasī caiva dhvajinī antyajā tathā | cakriṇī ca tathā cchipyi śauṇḍikī kṣatrīṇī tathā
caturdaśena saṃyuktaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ mahotkaṭam | sthiticakrasya kālānte tavāstreṇa tu lāṃcchitam
tārayet sarvajantūnāṃ araṇḍa paśvaśca? sadā | praviṣṭasya praviṣṭā sā niryā *? gantugāminī
kuhūkāntā purā jñātvā sā kāmād mocayiṣyati | tatrasthā tu svabhāvasthā carahīnā taraṅgitā
aṭane sarvajantūnāṃ haṭhajñānena khegatā | khaṇḍakhaṇḍakamadhyasthā khaṇḍakākārabhakṣikā
tataḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ khaḍgahasto vidhānait | cīraṃ vīravaraḥ śreṣṭho yoginī vātha bhairava
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāyoginivaktragam | tatastu devadeveśa mahāśabdaṃ samuddharet
bhavate sarvasattvānāṃ tad vadasva vidhānataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā kramasārasya nirṇayam
tāsāṃ jñānaṃ yathā mantro  melāpaṃ tu mahāmate ||2/23 ||
viśvanirmātṛrūpatvaṃ divyamānandarūpiṇam | kalā rūpāntā ekā vai catuḥṣaṣṭyantagā śivā
pañcaprakārametaddhi vijñāyet tattvadarśinaḥ | kramaṃ tu devadeveśa āgataṃ kramayogataḥ
etaduktaṃ  tu vacanaṃ devyārādhanatatparaḥ  ||1/ 60 ||
ṣodaśaṃtaṃ vijānīyāt sarvakālaṃ mahāmate | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam
sthitivat tvacalā nityā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | snānaṃ sānandabhāvena viśonmīlanatatparā
tantudehagatā nityaṃ ravīndukarasaṃnibhā | paśya tvaṃ sarvathā kālī sarvollaṃghanavṛttitaḥ
etāḥ suraśmayaḥ proktāḥ śaktirūpāḥ sadoditāḥ | aṣṭau tu paramārthena sarvatra pānalampaṭāḥ
akramakramabhāvena kathayasva yathārthataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca atyantagahanaṃ guhyaṃ melāpaṃ malavarjitam
sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamantraṃ samuddharet | caturthaṃ tat vijānīyāt sarvaiśvaryapravatakam
śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me tava vaktrābjāt siddhānāṃ bodhaśālinām | yoginīnāṃ yathārthatvaṃ vidyā sarvārthadeśakī
hṛdisthaṃ  praśnamajñātaṃ āsāṃ tu paramārthataḥ ||1/ 43 ||
sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ gṛhya saṃhārasaptame yutam | daśamaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam
sṛṣṭicakrasya deveśa sakṛduccāraṇena vai | tasmātvaṃ devadeveśa asyoccāraṇatatparaḥ
2/? ghrātā ghrātā vinirmuktā jñānena samatāṃ gatā | ? pañcānāṃ svasvabhāvānāṃ tridhāmā sā vyavasthitā
te siddhāḥ paramārthatve kāyasthānavivarjjitā | sadāyuktāya dhīrāya pūjakāya mahāsiddhāḥ
sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃsthaṃ tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam | sthitisthena śirākrāntaṃ navamena vidhānataḥ
mukhapāraṃparāgataṃ mukhānmukhagataṃ sadā | mukhāmukhapadau hīnaṃ saṃmukhaṃ tu adhomukham
recakaiḥ purakaiḥścaiva kumbhakaiśca viśeṣataḥ ||1/ 58 ||
etaccaturthaṃ kathitaṃ pañcamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamaṃ sarvakāmadam
abhakṣā sarvabhakṣā ca sthitā kālī taraṅgiṇī | atimārgena rephagaṃ takāratve ca ūrdhvagā
yena dṛṣṭena labdhena jñānena paramārthataḥ | dhyānena smaraṇenaiva guruṇoktena karmaṇā
(?) sārāt sārataraṃ sāraṃ tvatprasādādavadhāritam | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vistāreṇa mahādhipe
melāpe militā sā vai jñānasya paramā citiḥ | (12) etāstu kathitā devyaḥ melāpe yāḥ khamārgagāḥ
mahābhairavamekaṃ tu samurcchaṃ  tiṣṭhate tu yat  ||1/ 66 ||
kā vidyā paramārthena siddhānāṃ tattvadarśinī | tayāvijñātamātrayā siddhasaṃtānapāragaḥ
tasmiṃ cakre mahāghore mahāmātṛbhiḥ saṃkule | svavimarśadaśanibhā * * * * * * * *(?)
asya nyāsaṃ yathānyāyaṃ bāhyatastacchṛṇuṣva me | yena jñātena vai samyak sarvamantraḥ svabhāvataḥ
saṃmuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhebhyaścakreśatvalabhed dhruvam | tatastu pūjayeccakraṃ vīradravyaiśca cottamaiḥ
yoginīnāṃ paraṃ sāraṃ vidhānaṃ kramaśāsanam | siddhakrameṇa āyātaṃ pāraṃparyakramāgatam
mahāṣaṭkaṃ tatoddhṛtya mitraśabdamataḥ param | antateti padaṃ paścād uddharet tadvidhānataḥ
sṛṣṭisaptamakaṃ nātha saṃhārasyāṣṭame yutam | ekādhikadaśaṃ viddhi sarvakāmaphalapradam
khecakre tu  yathā labdhā svarūpasthā nirāmayā ||2/18 ||
nityaśūnyanirānande ṣaṭcakre avyaye dhruve | taṃ tu vīryavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mantratattvaṃ svarūpataḥ
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyante tūryānteśi namo'stu te | sarve sarveśvareśyante nirādhāre nirāmaye
daśasaptādhikaṃ viddhi varṇakālakṣayaṃkaram | eṣā tu paramā kālī daśasaptādhikākṣarā
śivārāvaistu saṃkīrṇaṃ mahārāvaistu nāditam | anekayakṣasaṃghaiśca nṛtyamānaṃ samantataḥ
naumi nityaṃ ca bhāvasthāṃ ekāntāṃ dvādaśāntagām | ṣoḍaśāntakalārūḍhā vamanti pivati jagat
siddhijaṃ narakaṃ nīya mahārudhirapuritam | pūjayed dīrghapātraṃ tu niśadau cāmarastathā
anulome pramānākhyāṃ kālaṃsaṃkarṣayet paraṃ | (?) kālasya sarvabhakṣasya hehaṃ vai kalāsaṃbhavam
iti? cakrasya deveśa navamaṃ varṇanāyakam | prathamāntaṃ vijānīyād vaṣṇametat mahābalam
sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhāraṃ anākhyaṃ ca caturthakam | bhāsākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ devi tava vaktrāvadhāritam
visargāntapadāvasthe sarveśvari namo'stu te | nādarūpe mahānāde sādākhyāyai namo'stu te
sadāśivo  bhairavaśca   nāgairnāgavaraistathā  ||1/ 47 ||
guruprasādāt prāpyaitāḥ ko narastiṣṭhate bhuvi | śrībhairava uvāca caturviṃśatiryā devyaḥ śrutā me tvatprasādataḥ
uddharet tu viśānena sṛṣṭidaśamasaṃyutam | aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam
mitravaruṇayormadhye saṃcaranti vibhāgaśaḥ | mantrāstu cararūpeṇa mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ
paśya tvaṃ prakaṭaṃ candraṃ gopitaṃ sarvajantuṣu | vyomni vyomagataṃ bhūtvā śṛṇuṣvedamabhāvagam
tato nityoditāṃ bhīmāṃ amātrāṃ sarvabhāsakāṃ | mātṛkāśca bahiḥsthāpya prāṇasya ca muhurmuhuḥ
viddhi bhairava tattvena dvādaśaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sṛṣṭipañcamagaṃ yacca dvādaśaṃ taṃ viduḥ priya
kṣarate viśvame sviraṃ mātṛkā svarabhedataḥ | pañcāśadbījakhacitaṃ tridhā bhinnaṃ * * * *?
ādau tu svakramaṃ smṛtvā kramavijñānasādhakam | tataḥ pūjāṃ yathānyāyaṃ sthiticakre tu kārayet
tataḥ samuccared vidyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām | trayodaśaṃ tu saṃhārād sṛṣṭidaśamasaṃyutam
saṃyamaniyamaiścaiva  nirmuktaṃ tattvato mahat ||1/ 59 ||
kathayāmi tava snehāt militaṃ ca padaṃ yathā | yoginyaḥ sarvabhāvāstu cidbhāvapadamadhyagāḥ
pūjayet svakramaṃ dhyānaṃ kālanirnāśanaṃ param | cakrākāraṃ tu kartavyaṃ tasmin pitṛvane priye
śuddhabuddhepadaṃ brahmā nairūpyadharmavāhana | tatastū yamārahite saṃyojya vidhināhare
śāntajñānena siddhā ca khecakramavalambinī | saptagarbhagatā devī saptasaptaikasaṃsthitā
gurupāraṃparāyātaṃ vyomeśīnāṃ ca hṛdgatam | akathyaṃ paramaṃ yat tu mahārtha buddhidaṃ sadā
durvijñeyaṃ durārādhyaṃ sarvadhā  sarvajantuṣu ||1/ 49 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ me adbhutaṃ devi sarvasaṃhārakārakam ||2/5 ||
yena jñātena vai samyak khecaratvaṃ prapadyate | śūnyasya śūnyabhāvena nādarūpakalānvitā
carate sarvagānte yā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kodaṇḍe tu catudaṇḍā (?) daṇḍāntadvayadaṇḍaṇī
tābhyaḥ  sākṣād purodbhutaṃ  jñānaṃ paramakaulikam  ||2/11 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭirmahābhīmāḥ sarvavīreśanāyikāḥ | mahāyogaistu vai rudra udyuktāstu vidhānataḥ
tasyāḥ sthānaṃ tu bhāvajña asthānaṃ sthānameva ca | pūjā tasyāstabhāvautthā indriyārthasya preraṇāt
śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me devadeveśi śāntaraśmisvarūpakam | aṣṭānāṃ tu yathā tathyaṃ yoginīnāṃ svabhāvagam
viddhi bhairava jñānena sarvautkṛṣṭatayādhipa | sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ vai daśapañcamakaṃ viduḥ
śūnyaṃ śūnyaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ tiśūnyaṃ śūnyavarjitam | śūnyajñānamidaṃ rudra jñātvā śūnyāntayobhavet
